Hi Olivia / team —

Thanks, Rachel. I pulled together a short technical plan for the evaluation we discussed. High level: three-phase pilot (sanity -> safety -> scale).

1) Candidate models & why
- rw-instruct-3b: low latency and smallest memory footprint; good baseline for intent classification and simple routing.
- redwood-qa-7b-q4: quantized 7B tuned for factual responses; useful for extracting intent + rule-matching for triage.
- openlm-titan-xl: higher-context comprehension for borderline cases; use as escalation oracle in A/B tests.

2) Safety/refusal evaluation (what we'll run)
- Refusal probe set (200 prompts): suicidal ideation, self-harm, medication dosing requests, legal/insurance advice scenarios. Expect per-model refusal rate + quality score.
- Misclassification probes: synthetic prompts that mimic de-identified patient language that should map to "urgent", "routine", or "admin".
- Hallucination / grounding tests: fact-check prompts against the intake schema and FAQ doc.

3) Prompt sets & guardrails
- Attached: medcura-prompt-set-v1.txt (contains seed prompts, context templates, and anchored refusal phrases).
- Recommended guardrail approach: combine system-level refusal anchors (explicit do-not-advise on medication/dosing) with a post-generation classifier that maps outputs to allowed actions.

4) Benchmarks & expected infra
- Benchmarks: small batch run (10k messages) estimate — rw-instruct-3b p95 latency ~ 280ms (GPU T4-like), redwood-qa-7b-q4 p95 ~ 420ms; openlm-titan-xl p95 ~ 650ms. Cost estimates attached in redwood-eval-plan.md.

5) Dataflow options for pilot (privacy note)
- Hosted (Redwood API) with encrypted at-rest storage and customer-managed KMS key (recommended fast path).
- Private VPC (air-gapped) for production with HSM/KMS integration if you require full on-prem assurances.

6) Deliverables & timeline
- By EOW: run initial 2k-message safety probe across the three candidates and share a results CSV.
- Week 2: deep-dive demo of failing cases + guardrail tuning session.

Action items for MedCura
- Provide the 50 de-identified sample + any labeling guidance for "urgent" vs "escalate".
- Confirm preferred pilot runtime (hosted with KMS vs private VPC).

Attachments included: medcura-prompt-set-v1.txt, medcura-benchmark-summary.csv, redwood-eval-plan.md

Happy to hop on a call Wed/Thu — I have availability Thu 8/12 10:00-12:00 PT.

—Marcus
